scope.description: Exactly one allowlisted service-probe action against the local DVWA container of the raphael-m1 compose lab. Everything not enumerated here is denied. This is NOT an open engagement policy; engagement-open-v0.json remains unwired and inactive.

invariants_enforced: INV-1: process/network/file primitives confined to exec/
INV-2: every execution event carries the Broker decision_id
INV-5: CLI -> Runtime; Runtime does not import arena
INV-7: no absolute hard-coded paths in new Runtime code

kill_switch.procedure: Swap the decision source to policies/bootstrap-v0.json (make_broker_from_bootstrap). The same D1 request is then denied on the action_type dimension and no process is spawned.

references.supersedes_nothing: engagement-open-v0.json exists but is not loaded by any code path and grants nothing here
